ACTOR_CHANGED.title: Access changed
ACTOR_CHANGED.when: The caller's access to the organization changed between the request starting and its write.
ACTOR_CHANGED.fix: Check the key's scopes and organization with GET /api/v1/api-keys/me, then send the request again.

ADMITS_TOO_MANY.title: Admits too many
ADMITS_TOO_MANY.when: Admit at most … pass types, counting each event's.
ADMITS_TOO_MANY.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

API_KEY_CHILD_CANNOT_MINT.title: Child key cannot mint keys
API_KEY_CHILD_CANNOT_MINT.when: A key that was itself created by a key tried to create a key.
API_KEY_CHILD_CANNOT_MINT.fix: Create the key with the original parent key or from a signed-in session.

API_KEY_CHILD_WIDER.title: Child key wider than its parent
API_KEY_CHILD_WIDER.when: The new key asks for a scope, mode or restriction broader than its parent key has.
API_KEY_CHILD_WIDER.fix: Request only scopes the parent key already holds, or create the key with a broader parent.

API_KEY_MODE_MISMATCH.title: Key mode mismatch
API_KEY_MODE_MISMATCH.when: You tried to rotate a key from the other mode (live or test).
API_KEY_MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Call the rotate endpoint with a key in the same mode as the key you rotate.

API_KEY_NOT_FOUND.title: Key not found
API_KEY_NOT_FOUND.when: No key with this id exists in the current mode and organization.
API_KEY_NOT_FOUND.fix: Look up the id with GET /api/v1/api-keys, using a key of the same mode.

API_KEY_NOT_ROTATABLE.title: Key cannot be rotated
API_KEY_NOT_ROTATABLE.when: The key is already revoked, retiring or expired.
API_KEY_NOT_ROTATABLE.fix: Create a new key with POST /api/v1/api-keys instead of rotating this one.

API_KEY_NO_APPROVAL.title: API key no approval
API_KEY_NO_APPROVAL.when: An API key cannot approve or override.
API_KEY_NO_APPROVAL.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

API_KEY_ORG_REQUIRED.title: API key org required
API_KEY_ORG_REQUIRED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

API_KEY_PARENT_RETIRING.title: Parent key retiring
API_KEY_PARENT_RETIRING.when: The key you called with is retiring, so it cannot create keys.
API_KEY_PARENT_RETIRING.fix: Create the key with a key that is not retiring.

API_KEY_REQUIRED.title: API key needed
API_KEY_REQUIRED.when: The route takes a key and got another credential.

API_KEY_RESTRICTED_ROUTE.title: Route outside key restriction
API_KEY_RESTRICTED_ROUTE.when: The key is limited to templates and cannot call this route.
API_KEY_RESTRICTED_ROUTE.fix: Call this route with a key that has no template restriction.

API_KEY_RESTRICTION_UNSUPPORTED.title: Restriction not supported
API_KEY_RESTRICTION_UNSUPPORTED.when: A templates or styles restriction was set on a key whose scopes it cannot narrow.
API_KEY_RESTRICTION_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Set templates and styles only on organization keys that hold pass, holder, template or NFC scopes.

API_KEY_RETIRE_SET.title: Key already retiring
API_KEY_RETIRE_SET.when: The key is already revoked or has a retirement date.
API_KEY_RETIRE_SET.fix: Leave the key as it is, or create a replacement with POST /api/v1/api-keys.

API_KEY_ROUTE.title: API key route
API_KEY_ROUTE.when: An API key cannot call this route.
API_KEY_ROUTE.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

API_KEY_SCAN_ORG_REQUIRED.title: Scan key needs an organization
API_KEY_SCAN_ORG_REQUIRED.when: A platform key was created with scan scopes.
API_KEY_SCAN_ORG_REQUIRED.fix: Create keys with scan scopes under an organization, not the platform.

API_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_CREATOR.title: Scope beyond the creator
API_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_CREATOR.when: The new key asks for scopes its creator does not hold.
API_KEY_SCOPE_EXCEEDS_CREATOR.fix: Request only scopes your own key or role holds.

API_KEY_TERMINALS_REQUIRED.title: Terminals required
API_KEY_TERMINALS_REQUIRED.when: A key with the scans:write scope was created without terminals.
API_KEY_TERMINALS_REQUIRED.fix: Set terminals to at least one terminal.

API_KEY_TERMINALS_UNUSED.title: Terminals not allowed
API_KEY_TERMINALS_UNUSED.when: terminals was set on a key without the scans:write scope.
API_KEY_TERMINALS_UNUSED.fix: Remove terminals, or add the scans:write scope.

ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE.title: Archive too large
ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE.when: The uploaded template archive is over 15 MB.
ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE.fix: Remove unused files and upload an archive under 15 MB.

ASSETS_INVALID.title: Invalid template assets
ASSETS_INVALID.when: An image in the template archive failed validation.
ASSETS_INVALID.fix: Fix the files named in issues and upload the archive again.

ASSET_DIMENSIONS.title: Image dimensions not allowed
ASSET_DIMENSIONS.when: The image's pixel size is outside what its slot accepts.
ASSET_DIMENSIONS.fix: Resize the image to the size named in issues and upload it again.

ASSET_NOT_FOUND.title: Image not found
ASSET_NOT_FOUND.when: No image with this name or id exists in this scope.
ASSET_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the image name or id and that it belongs to this organization.

ASSET_NOT_PNG.title: Image is not a readable PNG
ASSET_NOT_PNG.when: The upload is not a valid PNG, or uses a color format PassBook cannot read.
ASSET_NOT_PNG.fix: Re-export the image as a standard RGB or RGBA PNG and upload it again.

ASSET_SIZE.title: Image too large
ASSET_SIZE.fix: Compress the image below 1 MB and upload it again.

ASSET_SLOT.title: Unknown image slot
ASSET_SLOT.when: The image name does not match a slot on this pass or template.
ASSET_SLOT.fix: Use a slot name from the pass type's image slots in the request path.

BLOCK_NOT_FOUND.title: Block not found
BLOCK_NOT_FOUND.when: No block with this id exists for the holder.
BLOCK_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the block id and send the request again.

BLUEPRINT_NOT_SCANNABLE.title: Blueprint not scannable
BLUEPRINT_NOT_SCANNABLE.when: Make a template from this blueprint first.
BLUEPRINT_NOT_SCANNABLE.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

BRAND_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.title: Brand image not found
BRAND_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.when: The organization has no stored image for this slot or hash.
BRAND_IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Upload the image with PUT /api/v1/orgs/{id}/branding/{slot} and use the URL it returns.

BRAND_MARK_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Brand mark not on plan
BRAND_MARK_NOT_ALLOWED.when: The organization's plan does not include this branding setting.
BRAND_MARK_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Remove the setting, or ask the platform owner to enable it for the organization.

BROADCAST_INVALID_INPUT.title: Invalid broadcast input
BROADCAST_INVALID_INPUT.when: A value in the broadcast's patch does not match the template's input schema.
BROADCAST_INVALID_INPUT.fix: Fix the values named in issues; GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema lists the allowed inputs.

BROADCAST_NOT_CANCELLABLE.title: Broadcast not cancellable
BROADCAST_NOT_CANCELLABLE.when: The message has already started or finished; only drafts and scheduled messages cancel.
BROADCAST_NOT_CANCELLABLE.fix: Check the state with GET /api/v1/broadcasts/{id} and cancel only a draft or scheduled message.

BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT.title: Broadcast is not a draft
BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT.when: You tried to send a message that is not a draft.
BROADCAST_NOT_DRAFT.fix: Send only drafts, or create a new message with POST /api/v1/broadcasts.

BROADCAST_NOT_EDITABLE.title: Broadcast not editable
BROADCAST_NOT_EDITABLE.when: Only a draft or scheduled message can change; this one has started or finished.
BROADCAST_NOT_EDITABLE.fix: Create a new message with POST /api/v1/broadcasts instead.

BROADCAST_NOT_FOUND.title: Broadcast not found
BROADCAST_NOT_FOUND.when: No message with this id exists in this mode and organization.

BROADCAST_NOT_RETRYABLE.title: Broadcast not retryable
BROADCAST_NOT_RETRYABLE.when: Only a failed or cancelled message can be sent again.
BROADCAST_NOT_RETRYABLE.fix: Check the state with GET /api/v1/broadcasts/{id} and retry only a failed or cancelled message.

BROADCAST_ORG.title: Broadcast organization change
BROADCAST_ORG.when: The update tries to move the message to another organization.
BROADCAST_ORG.fix: Remove the organization change and update the message in its own organization.

BROADCAST_PAST.title: Send time in the past
BROADCAST_PAST.when: The at time is not in the future.
BROADCAST_PAST.fix: Set at to a future time.

BROADCAST_TOO_FAR.title: Send time too far out
BROADCAST_TOO_FAR.when: The at time is more than a year away.
BROADCAST_TOO_FAR.fix: Set at to a time within the next year.

BROADCAST_UNKNOWN_INPUT.title: Unknown broadcast input
BROADCAST_UNKNOWN_INPUT.when: The patch sets an input the target template does not have.
BROADCAST_UNKNOWN_INPUT.fix: Use only input names from GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema.

BULK_RUN_ACTIVE.title: Bulk run active
BULK_RUN_ACTIVE.when: Another bulk run on these passes is still in progress.
BULK_RUN_ACTIVE.fix: Wait for the running job to finish, then start the new one.

BUNDLE_DUPLICATE_PASS.title: Duplicate pass in bundle
BUNDLE_DUPLICATE_PASS.when: The same pass id appears twice in the bundle.

BUNDLE_EMPTY.title: No passes to bundle
BUNDLE_EMPTY.when: The bundle has no passes to add.
BUNDLE_EMPTY.fix: Add at least one pass to the bundle.

BUNDLE_MODE_MISMATCH.title: Bundle mode mismatch
BUNDLE_MODE_MISMATCH.when: The bundle mixes live and test passes.
BUNDLE_MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Put only passes of the bundle's mode in it.

BUNDLE_NOT_FOUND.title: Bundle not found
BUNDLE_NOT_FOUND.when: No bundle with this id exists in this mode and organization.

BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE.title: Bundle too large
BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE.when: The bundle's passes exceed the size limit for one download.
BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE.fix: Split the passes across smaller bundles.

BUNDLE_TOO_MANY.title: Too many passes in bundle
BUNDLE_TOO_MANY.when: The bundle lists more than 10 passes.
BUNDLE_TOO_MANY.fix: Send at most 10 passes per bundle.

CAPTURED_EMAIL_NOT_FOUND.title: Test email not found
CAPTURED_EMAIL_NOT_FOUND.when: No captured email with this id exists in the test inbox.
CAPTURED_EMAIL_NOT_FOUND.fix: List emails with GET /api/v1/test-inbox and use an id from the result.

CONNECTION_CONFLICT.title: Connection changed
CONNECTION_CONFLICT.when: Another request changed the connection while yours was running.
CONNECTION_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/connections/{id} and send the change again.

CONNECTION_DISABLED.title: Connection disabled
CONNECTION_DISABLED.when: The connection is disabled, so it cannot run this action.
CONNECTION_DISABLED.fix: Enable it with PATCH /api/v1/connections/{id}, then send the request again.

CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND.title: Connection not found
CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND.when: No connection with this id exists in this mode and organization.

CONNECTION_ORG.title: Connection in another organization
CONNECTION_ORG.when: The connection belongs to a different organization than the pass.
CONNECTION_ORG.fix: Use a connection id from your own organization's GET /api/v1/connections.

CONNECTION_TRANSFER_PENDING.title: Holder transfer pending
CONNECTION_TRANSFER_PENDING.when: The holder is moving between providers and the old provider has not retired yet.
CONNECTION_TRANSFER_PENDING.fix: Wait for the transfer to finish, then send the request again.

CONNECTOR_NOT_FOUND.title: Connector type not found
CONNECTOR_NOT_FOUND.when: No connector type has this name.

CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN.title: Unknown connector type
CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN.when: The connection's type is not a known connector.
CONNECTOR_UNKNOWN.fix: Set type to a value from GET /api/v1/connectors.

CREATE_STALE.title: Pass create raced
CREATE_STALE.when: Another pass was created with this externalId while yours was being created.
CREATE_STALE.fix: Look the pass up by externalId with GET /api/v1/passes and update it instead of creating it again.

CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE.title: Credential references unavailable
CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE.when: The server's credential-reference keyset is not configured right now.
CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_CONFIG_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Retry with backoff; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_UNAVAILABLE.title: Credential references unavailable
CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_UNAVAILABLE.when: The stored credential-reference keyset could not be loaded.
CREDENTIAL_REF_KEYSET_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Retry with backoff; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

CSRF_ORIGIN.title: Cross-origin request blocked
CSRF_ORIGIN.when: A browser session request came from an origin other than PassBook's own.
CSRF_ORIGIN.fix: Call the API server-side with an API key in the Authorization header instead of from a browser page.

DELIVERY_PENDING.title: Delivery already queued
DELIVERY_PENDING.when: The delivery you replay is already waiting to be sent.
DELIVERY_PENDING.fix: Wait for it to send, then check GET /api/v1/webhook-endpoints/{id}/deliveries before replaying.

DELIVERY_STALE.title: Delivery stale
DELIVERY_STALE.fix: Review the recipient and try again.

DEVICE_REQUIRED.title: Device required
DEVICE_REQUIRED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

DEVICE_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE.title: Device token unavailable
DEVICE_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE.when: The pass's device authentication token could not be built.
DEVICE_TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Retry the request; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

EMAIL_INVALID.title: Invalid email address
EMAIL_INVALID.when: The email value is not a valid address.
EMAIL_INVALID.fix: Send a valid address in the email field.

EMAIL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.title: Email outcome unknown
EMAIL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.when: The mail provider did not confirm whether the earlier send went out.
EMAIL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.fix: Check the pass's delivery status before sending again, to avoid a duplicate email.

EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED.title: Email rate limited
EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED.when: The request ran into email rate limited.

ENROLLMENT_ENDED.title: Enrollment ended
ENROLLMENT_ENDED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Enrollment not found
ENROLLMENT_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

ENTITLEMENTS_CHANGED.title: Entitlements changed
ENTITLEMENTS_CHANGED.when: Another request changed the organization's features while yours was running.
ENTITLEMENTS_CHANGED.fix: Fetch them with GET /api/v1/orgs/{id}/entitlements and send your change again.

EVENT_ARCHIVED.title: Event archived
EVENT_ARCHIVED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

EVENT_IN_USE.title: Event in use
EVENT_IN_USE.when: A session already uses this event.
EVENT_IN_USE.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

EVENT_MATCH_INPUT.title: Event match input
EVENT_MATCH_INPUT.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

EVENT_NEEDS_CAPACITY.title: Event needs capacity
EVENT_NEEDS_CAPACITY.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

EVENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Event not found
EVENT_NOT_FOUND.when: No event with this id exists in this mode and organization.

EVENT_TEMPLATE_NO_CHECK_IN.title: Event template no check in
EVENT_TEMPLATE_NO_CHECK_IN.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

EVENT_TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.title: Event template release required
EVENT_TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.when: Every event template needs an approved release or an eligible legacy pass in this mode.
EVENT_TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

EXPIRY_PAST.title: Expiry in the past
EXPIRY_PAST.when: expiresAt is not in the future.
EXPIRY_PAST.fix: Send a future time in milliseconds.

EXTERNAL_ID_TAKEN.title: externalId in use
EXTERNAL_ID_TAKEN.when: Another pass of this template has that externalId.
EXTERNAL_ID_TAKEN.fix: Send a new externalId, or PATCH the existing pass.

FORBIDDEN.title: Not allowed
FORBIDDEN.when: The key is valid but may not do this.
FORBIDDEN.fix: Use a key with the scope the operation lists, or ask an org admin.

GOOGLE_CALLBACK_INVALID.title: Google callback invalid
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_INVALID.fix: Send a valid API key in the Authorization header.

GOOGLE_CALLBACK_UNAVAILABLE.title: Google callback unavailable
GOOGLE_CALLBACK_UNAVAILABLE.when: Google Wallet callback service is unavailable.

GRANT_BAD_PURPOSE.title: Grant bad purpose
GRANT_BAD_PURPOSE.when: Webhook writes need an org_mode grant.
GRANT_BAD_PURPOSE.fix: Retry once; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

GRANT_FOREIGN_STATEMENT.title: Grant foreign statement
GRANT_FOREIGN_STATEMENT.when: The keyset statement was not captured.
GRANT_FOREIGN_STATEMENT.fix: Retry once; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

GRANT_SCOPE_OVERRIDE.title: Grant scope override
GRANT_SCOPE_OVERRIDE.when: A miss window binds as many values as it has marks.
GRANT_SCOPE_OVERRIDE.fix: Retry once; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

GROUP_ENTRY_ONLY.title: Group entry only
GROUP_ENTRY_ONLY.when: Check in all is for entry scanners.
GROUP_ENTRY_ONLY.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

HOLDER_CHANGED.title: Holder changed
HOLDER_CHANGED.when: The pass's holder changed while your request ran.
HOLDER_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the pass with GET /api/v1/passes/{id} and send the request again.

HOLDER_EMAIL_INVALID.title: Holder email invalid
HOLDER_EMAIL_INVALID.when: The email on the upstream record is not a valid address.
HOLDER_EMAIL_INVALID.fix: Correct the email in the source system, then sync the connection again.

HOLDER_OWNED.title: Pass already has an owner
HOLDER_OWNED.when: The pass is already owned by a user, so it cannot be assigned.

HOLDER_TRANSFER_PENDING.title: Holder transfer pending
HOLDER_TRANSFER_PENDING.when: A holder transfer on this pass has not finished.
HOLDER_TRANSFER_PENDING.fix: Wait for the transfer to finish, then send the request again.

IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.title: First request still running
IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.when: A request with this Idempotency-Key has not finished.
IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS.fix: Wait a moment and resend the identical request.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.title: Bad Idempotency-Key
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.when: Idempotency-Key is empty or longer than 200 characters.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_INVALID.fix: Send a unique string of 1 to 200 characters, such as a UUID.

IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.title: Idempotency-Key reused
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.when: The same Idempotency-Key came with a different request.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.fix: Use a new key for a new request; resend the identical request to replay.

IDENTITY_NOT_FOUND.title: Signing identity not found
IDENTITY_NOT_FOUND.when: No signing identity with this id exists in this mode and organization.

IF_MATCH_INVALID.title: Bad If-Match
IF_MATCH_INVALID.when: If-Match is not a pass version number.
IF_MATCH_INVALID.fix: Send the version from the last GET, for example If-Match: 3.

IMAGE_BYTES.title: Image file too large
IMAGE_BYTES.when: A brand image is over its size limit (200 KB for slots, 512 KB for the web logo).
IMAGE_BYTES.fix: Compress the image and upload it again.

IMAGE_INVALID.title: Image invalid
IMAGE_INVALID.when: The upload is not a valid PNG.
IMAGE_INVALID.fix: Export a standard PNG and upload it again.

IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.title: Image not found
IMAGE_NOT_FOUND.when: The organization has no image for this slot.

IMAGE_SCALE.title: Image scales do not match
IMAGE_SCALE.when: The @2x image is not two thirds the size of the @3x image.
IMAGE_SCALE.fix: Resize so the @2x image is two thirds of the @3x, then upload both.

IMAGE_SIZE.title: Image size not allowed
IMAGE_SIZE.when: The image's pixel size is outside what the slot accepts.
IMAGE_SIZE.fix: Resize to the size named in issues and upload it again.

IMPORT_BUSY.title: Import already running
IMPORT_BUSY.when: This import, or another import of the same template, is running.
IMPORT_BUSY.fix: Wait for it to finish with GET /api/v1/pass-imports/{id}, then retry.

IMPORT_COLUMN_MISSING.title: Import column missing
IMPORT_COLUMN_MISSING.when: The file has no column for a field the mapping needs.
IMPORT_COLUMN_MISSING.fix: Add the column to the file, or change the mapping, then check again.

IMPORT_CONFLICT.title: Import not queued
IMPORT_CONFLICT.when: The import could not be queued.

IMPORT_EXPIRED.title: Import expired
IMPORT_EXPIRED.when: The import's checked file expired before you committed it.
IMPORT_EXPIRED.fix: Upload the file again with POST /api/v1/pass-imports.

IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS.title: Import has errors
IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS.when: Some rows have errors and the import is set to stop on errors.
IMPORT_HAS_ERRORS.fix: Fix the rows listed in GET /api/v1/pass-imports/{id}/errors.csv, or skip them, then commit again.

IMPORT_HEADER_TOO_LONG.title: Import header too long
IMPORT_HEADER_TOO_LONG.when: A column header in the file is over the length limit.
IMPORT_HEADER_TOO_LONG.fix: Shorten the header and upload the file again.

IMPORT_ID_TAKEN.title: Import pass id taken
IMPORT_ID_TAKEN.when: The pass id reserved for an import row is already used by another pass.
IMPORT_ID_TAKEN.fix: Check the import again with POST /api/v1/pass-imports/{id}/check, then commit.

IMPORT_NOT_FOUND.title: Import not found
IMPORT_NOT_FOUND.when: No import with this id exists in this mode and organization.

IMPORT_PASS_CHANGED.title: Imported pass edited
IMPORT_PASS_CHANGED.when: The pass was edited after the import, so it cannot be removed with it.
IMPORT_PASS_CHANGED.fix: Remove the pass on its own with POST /api/v1/passes/{id}/remove.

IMPORT_PLAN_INVALID.title: Import mapping invalid
IMPORT_PLAN_INVALID.when: The column mapping does not match the template's inputs.
IMPORT_PLAN_INVALID.fix: Fix the mapping entries named in issues and check again.

IMPORT_ROW_UNRESERVED.title: Import row has no pass
IMPORT_ROW_UNRESERVED.when: The server did not reserve a pass id for an import row.
IMPORT_ROW_UNRESERVED.fix: Retry the commit; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

IMPORT_STATE.title: Import in the wrong state
IMPORT_STATE.when: The import is not in a state that allows this action, such as results before it ran.
IMPORT_STATE.fix: Check its state with GET /api/v1/pass-imports/{id} and call the action that state allows.

INVALID_API_KEY.title: Invalid API key
INVALID_API_KEY.when: The key is unknown, revoked or expired.
INVALID_API_KEY.fix: Create a new key in the console and update PASSBOOK_KEY.

INVALID_CURSOR.title: Bad cursor
INVALID_CURSOR.when: cursor is not one a list returned.
INVALID_CURSOR.fix: Pass the nextCursor from the previous page unchanged, or drop it to start over.

INVALID_INPUT.title: Invalid pass input
INVALID_INPUT.when: The pass input does not match the template's input schema.
INVALID_INPUT.fix: Fix the inputs named in issues; GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema lists them.

INVITATION_INVALID.title: Invitation invalid
INVITATION_INVALID.when: The invitation token is wrong, used or expired.
INVITATION_INVALID.fix: Ask an organization admin to send a new invitation with POST /api/v1/orgs/{id}/invitations.

INVITATION_PENDING.title: Invitation pending
INVITATION_PENDING.when: This address already has a pending invitation.
INVITATION_PENDING.fix: Revoke it to send a new one.

JOIN_NOT_READY.title: Join link not ready
JOIN_NOT_READY.when: The template is not ready for a join link, for example it has no published version.
JOIN_NOT_READY.fix: Publish the template, then enable the link with PUT /api/v1/join-links/{templateId}.

KEYSET_CHANGED.title: Keyset changed
KEYSET_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

KEYSET_KEY_INVALID.title: Keyset key invalid
KEYSET_KEY_INVALID.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

KEYSET_KEY_NOT_FOUND.title: Keyset key not found
KEYSET_KEY_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

KEYSET_KEY_REUSED.title: Keyset key reused
KEYSET_KEY_REUSED.when: Enter keys this organization has not used.
KEYSET_KEY_REUSED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

KEYSET_KEY_WEAK.title: Keyset key weak
KEYSET_KEY_WEAK.when: Use two different keys, and not the factory default.
KEYSET_KEY_WEAK.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

KEYSET_NOT_FOUND.title: Keyset not found
KEYSET_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

KEY_CREATOR_GONE.title: Key creator deleted
KEY_CREATOR_GONE.when: The user who created this key no longer exists.
KEY_CREATOR_GONE.fix: Create a new key with POST /api/v1/api-keys.

KEY_CREATOR_NOT_MEMBER.title: Key creator left the organization
KEY_CREATOR_NOT_MEMBER.when: The user who created this key is no longer a member of the organization.
KEY_CREATOR_NOT_MEMBER.fix: Create a new key from a current member with POST /api/v1/api-keys.

KEY_TEST_ONLY.title: Test key only
KEY_TEST_ONLY.when: The operation is limited to Test keys.

LAST_ORG_ADMIN.title: Last org admin
LAST_ORG_ADMIN.when: This is the last org admin.
LAST_ORG_ADMIN.fix: Make someone else an org admin first.

LINK_NOT_FOUND.title: Link not found
LINK_NOT_FOUND.when: The link token is unknown, rotated or expired.
LINK_NOT_FOUND.fix: Request a fresh link, for example with POST /api/v1/bundles/{id}/rotate-link.

MANIFEST_INVALID.title: Manifest invalid
MANIFEST_INVALID.when: wallet.template.json is missing, not valid JSON or fails the manifest schema.
MANIFEST_INVALID.fix: Fix the manifest fields listed in issues and upload it again.

MATCH_NEEDS_TEMPLATE.title: Input filter needs a template
MATCH_NEEDS_TEMPLATE.when: The pass list filters by input without naming an organization and template.
MATCH_NEEDS_TEMPLATE.fix: Send orgId and templateId with the input filter.

MEMBERSHIP_CONFLICT.title: Membership conflict
MEMBERSHIP_CONFLICT.when: The membership changed while the request ran.
MEMBERSHIP_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/orgs/{id}/memberships and send the change again.

MEMBER_PHOTO_CHANGED.title: Member photo changed
MEMBER_PHOTO_CHANGED.when: The pass or its photo changed while the photo was saving.
MEMBER_PHOTO_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the pass with GET /api/v1/passes/{id} and save the photo again.

MEMBER_PHOTO_DIMENSIONS.title: Member photo size wrong
MEMBER_PHOTO_DIMENSIONS.when: The photo is not the required square size.
MEMBER_PHOTO_DIMENSIONS.fix: Crop the photo to a 270 by 270 pixel square and upload it again.

MEMBER_PHOTO_ENCODING.title: Member photo unreadable
MEMBER_PHOTO_ENCODING.when: The photo file could not be decoded as an image.
MEMBER_PHOTO_ENCODING.fix: Send the photo as a PNG or JPEG file.

MEMBER_PHOTO_NOT_FOUND.title: Member photo not found
MEMBER_PHOTO_NOT_FOUND.when: The pass has no member photo.

MEMBER_PHOTO_STYLE.title: Pass style cannot hold a photo
MEMBER_PHOTO_STYLE.when: A member photo needs a generic or event ticket pass without a strip image.
MEMBER_PHOTO_STYLE.fix: Use a template of that style, or remove the strip image.

MESSAGING_UNSUPPORTED.title: Template has no message field
MESSAGING_UNSUPPORTED.when: The template has no message field to update.
MESSAGING_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Use a template that defines a message field, or add one to it.

MISSING_SCOPE.title: Missing scope
MISSING_SCOPE.when: The key lacks a scope this operation needs.
MISSING_SCOPE.fix: Create a key with the scope the operation lists under security.

MODE_MISMATCH.title: Mode mismatch
MODE_MISMATCH.when: The request mixes test and live objects, for example a test pass with a live connection.
MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Use objects and a key of the same mode.

MODE_UNSUPPORTED.title: Mode not supported
MODE_UNSUPPORTED.when: The connector does not support the requested mode.
MODE_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Create the connection in a mode the connector supports; GET /api/v1/connectors/{type} lists them.

NEW_CODE_UNSUPPORTED.title: New code not supported
NEW_CODE_UNSUPPORTED.when: The pass's barcode is not its scan code, so a new code cannot replace it.
NEW_CODE_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Reissue the pass with POST /api/v1/passes/bulk-reissue instead of requesting a new code.

NOTE_CAP.title: Note cap
NOTE_CAP.when: This device has added all it can to this person today.
NOTE_CAP.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

NOTE_DEVICE_CAP.title: Note device cap
NOTE_DEVICE_CAP.when: This device has added all it can to this person today.
NOTE_DEVICE_CAP.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

NOTE_NOT_FOUND.title: Note not found
NOTE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

NOTE_ROLE.title: Note role
NOTE_ROLE.when: Only Desk staff can read notes.
NOTE_ROLE.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

NOT_A_ZIP.title: Not a zip file
NOT_A_ZIP.when: The uploaded file is not a zip archive.
NOT_A_ZIP.fix: Upload the template as a .zip file.

NOT_FOUND.title: Not found
NOT_FOUND.when: The id does not exist in your organization and mode.
NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, and that the key's mode (test or live) matches the object.

NOT_INSIDE.title: Not inside
NOT_INSIDE.when: The person is already marked out.
NOT_INSIDE.fix: Do nothing; check occupancy before marking out.

NO_FILE.title: No file attached
NO_FILE.when: The request has no file field.
NO_FILE.fix: Send the archive as multipart form data in the file field.

NO_RECIPIENT.title: No recipient
NO_RECIPIENT.when: The pass has no holder email to send to.
NO_RECIPIENT.fix: Set the holder's email with PATCH /api/v1/passes/{id}, then send again.

NO_VERIFIED_EMAIL.title: No verified email
NO_VERIFIED_EMAIL.when: The user has no verified email address to send the test to.
NO_VERIFIED_EMAIL.fix: Verify an email address on the account, then send again.

OFFLINE_OFF.title: Offline off
OFFLINE_OFF.when: This session does not use an offline list.
OFFLINE_OFF.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

OFFLINE_TOO_BIG.title: Offline too big
OFFLINE_TOO_BIG.when: Too many passes for an offline list.

ORG_ACCESS_CHANGED.title: Organization access changed
ORG_ACCESS_CHANGED.when: The caller's membership or key access changed while the request ran.
ORG_ACCESS_CHANGED.fix: Check access with GET /api/v1/api-keys/me, then send the request again.

ORG_CONFLICT.title: Organization changed
ORG_CONFLICT.when: Another request changed the organization while yours ran.
ORG_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/orgs/{id} and send the change again.

ORG_FORBIDDEN.title: Organization not accessible
ORG_FORBIDDEN.when: The key or scanner cannot access this organization, or a platform-wide list needs a platform key.
ORG_FORBIDDEN.fix: Use a key scoped to this organization, or a platform key for platform-wide lists.

ORG_INACTIVE.title: Organization inactive
ORG_INACTIVE.when: The organization is suspended or closed.
ORG_INACTIVE.fix: Reactivate it with POST /api/v1/orgs/{orgId}/reopen or ask the platform owner.

ORG_MIXED.title: Passes from several organizations
ORG_MIXED.when: The ids belong to more than one organization.
ORG_MIXED.fix: Send ids from one organization per request.

ORG_NOT_FOUND.title: Organization not found
ORG_NOT_FOUND.when: No organization with this id exists.

ORG_REQUIRED.title: Organization required
ORG_REQUIRED.when: The request spans organizations and does not name one.
ORG_REQUIRED.fix: Send orgId with the request, or use a key scoped to one organization.

ORG_SLUG_TAKEN.title: Slug taken
ORG_SLUG_TAKEN.when: Another organization already uses this slug.

ORG_STATUS_ALONE.title: Status change must be alone
ORG_STATUS_ALONE.when: The update changes the status and other fields together.
ORG_STATUS_ALONE.fix: Send the status change in its own request, then the other edits.

PASS_CONFLICT.title: Pass changed
PASS_CONFLICT.when: The pass changed or lost its owner while the request ran.
PASS_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch the pass with GET /api/v1/passes/{id} and send the request again.

PASS_CONNECTION_MISMATCH.title: Pass not linked to this connection
PASS_CONNECTION_MISMATCH.when: The pass is not linked to the connection, or its connection is incomplete.
PASS_CONNECTION_MISMATCH.fix: Link it with PUT /api/v1/passes/{id}/connection, then send the request again.

PASS_FILE_MISSING.title: Pass file missing
PASS_FILE_MISSING.when: The stored pass file is not available.

PASS_INPUT_INVALID.title: Pass input invalid
PASS_INPUT_INVALID.when: The inputs do not match the template's input schema.
PASS_INPUT_INVALID.fix: Fix the inputs named in issues; GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema lists them.

PASS_INVALID.title: Pass invalid
PASS_INVALID.when: The built pass fails pass-format validation.
PASS_INVALID.fix: Fix the problems named in issues in the template or inputs.

PASS_NOT_ACTIVE.title: Pass not active
PASS_NOT_ACTIVE.when: The action needs an active pass, and this one is voided, expired or removed.
PASS_NOT_ACTIVE.fix: Restore or unvoid the pass first, or use an active one.

PASS_NOT_FOUND.title: Pass not found
PASS_NOT_FOUND.when: No pass with this id exists in this mode and organization.
PASS_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id with GET /api/v1/passes and the key's mode.

PASS_REF_TAKEN.title: Connection ref in use
PASS_REF_TAKEN.when: Another pass already uses this connection ref.
PASS_REF_TAKEN.fix: Use a different ref, or update the existing pass.

PASS_REISSUE_REQUIRED.title: Reissue required
PASS_REISSUE_REQUIRED.when: The pass's scanner credential was retired and cannot be reused.

PASS_REMOVED.title: Pass removed
PASS_REMOVED.when: The pass was removed from the holder's wallet.
PASS_REMOVED.fix: Restore it with POST /api/v1/passes/{id}/restore, then send the request again.

PASS_TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND.title: Pass transfer not found
PASS_TRANSFER_NOT_FOUND.when: No transfer with this id exists for the pass.

PASS_TRANSFER_PENDING.title: Pass transfer pending
PASS_TRANSFER_PENDING.when: This pass is being transferred while its existing wallet credentials are retired.

PHOTO_PASS_INACTIVE.title: Photo pass inactive
PHOTO_PASS_INACTIVE.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

PHOTO_ROLE.title: Photo role
PHOTO_ROLE.when: Only Desk staff can add photos.
PHOTO_ROLE.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

PIN_GENERATION_FAILED.title: PIN generation failed
PIN_GENERATION_FAILED.when: Could not generate a new PIN.

PIN_MANAGER_REQUIRED.title: PIN manager required
PIN_MANAGER_REQUIRED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Rate limited
RATE_LIMITED.when: The key went over its request limit.
RATE_LIMITED.fix: Wait for Retry-After seconds, then retry. Back off on repeats.

RECIPIENT_NOT_HOLDER.title: Recipient is not the holder
RECIPIENT_NOT_HOLDER.when: The email is not the holder's address on the pass or bundle.
RECIPIENT_NOT_HOLDER.fix: Send to the holder's email, or change it with PATCH /api/v1/passes/{id}.

REPLAY_NOT_QUEUED.title: Replay not queued
REPLAY_NOT_QUEUED.when: The queue was unavailable, so no deliveries were queued.

REPLAY_TOO_LARGE.title: Replay range too large
REPLAY_TOO_LARGE.when: The replay range holds more deliveries than one replay allows.
REPLAY_TOO_LARGE.fix: Narrow the time range or replay in several smaller requests.

REPLY_TO_LINK_INVALID.title: Reply-to link invalid
REPLY_TO_LINK_INVALID.when: The confirmation link is wrong, used or expired.
REPLY_TO_LINK_INVALID.fix: Request a new link with POST /api/v1/settings/reply-to/resend.

REPLY_TO_NOTHING_PENDING.title: No reply-to to confirm
REPLY_TO_NOTHING_PENDING.when: No reply-to address is waiting for confirmation.
REPLY_TO_NOTHING_PENDING.fix: Set a new reply-to address with PUT /api/v1/settings first.

REPLY_TO_RESEND_LIMITED.title: Reply-to resend limited
REPLY_TO_RESEND_LIMITED.when: A confirmation link was sent less than a minute ago.
REPLY_TO_RESEND_LIMITED.fix: Wait a minute, then call POST /api/v1/settings/reply-to/resend again.

RETENTION_RECEIPT_BUSY.title: Retention receipt busy
RETENTION_RECEIPT_BUSY.when: Another retention job is writing the organization's receipt chain.
RETENTION_RECEIPT_BUSY.fix: Wait a few seconds and send the request again.

ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Role not allowed
ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED.when: This device cannot change its role.
ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

ROLL_CALL_ENDED.title: Roll call ended
ROLL_CALL_ENDED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

ROLL_CALL_NOT_FOUND.title: Roll call not found
ROLL_CALL_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

ROLL_CALL_NO_PLACES.title: Roll call no places
ROLL_CALL_NO_PLACES.when: Nothing is tracked here, so there is no one to call.
ROLL_CALL_NO_PLACES.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

ROLL_CALL_NO_SESSION.title: Roll call no session
ROLL_CALL_NO_SESSION.when: This device is not in a scanning session.
ROLL_CALL_NO_SESSION.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

ROLL_CALL_TOO_LARGE.title: Roll call too large
ROLL_CALL_TOO_LARGE.when: Too many people inside to freeze a list.
ROLL_CALL_TOO_LARGE.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

RULE_HOURS_NEED_DATETIME.title: Quiet hours need a date and time
RULE_HOURS_NEED_DATETIME.when: The rule uses hours but its date input is a date without a time.
RULE_HOURS_NEED_DATETIME.fix: Use a date-and-time input for the rule, or remove the hours.

RULE_INPUT_MISMATCH.title: Rule inputs differ across templates
RULE_INPUT_MISMATCH.when: The rule's date input is a date on one template and a date and time on another.
RULE_INPUT_MISMATCH.fix: Pick templates where the input has the same type.

RULE_INPUT_MISSING.title: Rule input missing
RULE_INPUT_MISSING.when: A template in the rule has no input with the name the rule uses.
RULE_INPUT_MISSING.fix: Use an input name from GET /api/v1/templates/{id}/input-schema for every template.

RULE_LIMIT.title: Automatic message limit reached
RULE_LIMIT.when: The organization already has the maximum number of automatic messages on.
RULE_LIMIT.fix: Pause one with POST /api/v1/message-rules/{id}/pause, then turn this one on.

RULE_NOT_FOUND.title: Automatic message not found
RULE_NOT_FOUND.when: No rule with this id exists in this mode and organization.

RULE_VERSION.title: Rule changed
RULE_VERSION.when: Someone changed the rule after you loaded it.
RULE_VERSION.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/message-rules/{id} and send your change again.

SAMPLE_TEST_ONLY.title: Sample test only
SAMPLE_TEST_ONLY.when: Sample passes are for test scanners.
SAMPLE_TEST_ONLY.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SAMSUNG_FIELDS_INVALID.title: Samsung fields invalid
SAMSUNG_FIELDS_INVALID.fix: Correct the request and send it again.

SAMSUNG_UNAUTHENTICATED.title: Samsung unauthenticated
SAMSUNG_UNAUTHENTICATED.fix: Send a valid API key in the Authorization header.

SANDBOX_PREVIEW_ONLY.title: Preview only
SANDBOX_PREVIEW_ONLY.when: A sandbox pass was asked to install in Wallet.
SANDBOX_PREVIEW_ONLY.fix: Use the preview card and QR in the console; live passes need a real organization.

SANDBOX_QUOTA.title: Sandbox quota reached
SANDBOX_QUOTA.when: A developer sandbox hit its cap on passes, templates or webhook endpoints.
SANDBOX_QUOTA.fix: Delete test objects you no longer need, or move to an organization with live access.

SCANNER_ADMIN_ROLE.title: Scanner admin role
SCANNER_ADMIN_ROLE.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCANNER_ADMIN_SETUP_EXISTS.title: Scanner admin setup exists
SCANNER_ADMIN_SETUP_EXISTS.when: Use the existing admin setup in that mode.
SCANNER_ADMIN_SETUP_EXISTS.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCANNER_ADMIN_USER.title: Scanner admin user
SCANNER_ADMIN_USER.when: An admin setup belongs to the admin who creates it.
SCANNER_ADMIN_USER.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCANNER_CANNOT_SCAN.title: Scanner cannot scan
SCANNER_CANNOT_SCAN.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCANNER_CHANGED.title: Scanner changed
SCANNER_CHANGED.fix: Reload its settings and try again.

SCANNER_EXPIRED.title: Scanner expired
SCANNER_EXPIRED.fix: Send a valid API key in the Authorization header.

SCANNER_NAME_TAKEN.title: Scanner name taken
SCANNER_NAME_TAKEN.when: Another scanner already has that name.
SCANNER_NAME_TAKEN.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCANNER_NOT_FOUND.title: Scanner not found
SCANNER_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

SCANNER_NOT_PAIRABLE.title: Scanner not pairable
SCANNER_NOT_PAIRABLE.when: Only browser devices pair with a code.
SCANNER_NOT_PAIRABLE.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCANNER_NOT_TERMINAL.title: Scanner not terminal
SCANNER_NOT_TERMINAL.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCANNER_NO_TAGS.title: Scanner no tags
SCANNER_NO_TAGS.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCANNER_REPAIR.title: Scanner must pair again
SCANNER_REPAIR.when: The scanner's credential no longer verifies.
SCANNER_REPAIR.fix: Pair the scanner again with a new code.

SCANNER_REQUESTS_OFF.title: Scanner requests off
SCANNER_REQUESTS_OFF.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCANNER_REVOKED.title: Scanner revoked
SCANNER_REVOKED.fix: Send a valid API key in the Authorization header.

SCANNER_ROLE_INVALID.title: Scanner role invalid
SCANNER_ROLE_INVALID.when: Choose a role this device supports.
SCANNER_ROLE_INVALID.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCANNER_SETUP_EXISTS.title: Scanner setup exists
SCANNER_SETUP_EXISTS.when: A setup with this name or admin already exists.
SCANNER_SETUP_EXISTS.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCANNER_UNASSIGNED.title: Scanner unassigned
SCANNER_UNASSIGNED.when: Choose what this scanner accepts first.
SCANNER_UNASSIGNED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCANNER_UNAUTHENTICATED.title: Scanner unauthenticated
SCANNER_UNAUTHENTICATED.fix: Send a valid API key in the Authorization header.

SCANNER_WATCH_INVALID.title: Scanner watch invalid
SCANNER_WATCH_INVALID.when: Choose the scanners or sessions this screen should follow.
SCANNER_WATCH_INVALID.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCANNER_WATCH_MODE.title: Scanner watch mode
SCANNER_WATCH_MODE.when: Move the watched scanners, sessions and event to that mode first.
SCANNER_WATCH_MODE.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCANNER_WATCH_NOT_FOUND.title: Scanner watch not found
SCANNER_WATCH_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

SCANNING_DEVICE_CHANGED.title: Scanning device changed
SCANNING_DEVICE_CHANGED.fix: Reload its settings and try again.

SCANNING_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.title: Scanning device not found
SCANNING_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

SCANNING_HOLD_RANGE.title: Scanning hold range
SCANNING_HOLD_RANGE.fix: Correct the request and send it again.

SCANNING_HOURS_NONE.title: Scanning hours none
SCANNING_HOURS_NONE.when: Nothing opens in the next 8 days.

SCANNING_SESSION_CHANGED.title: Scanning session changed
SCANNING_SESSION_CHANGED.fix: Reload its settings and try again.

SCANNING_SESSION_CLOSED.title: Scanning session closed
SCANNING_SESSION_CLOSED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCANNING_SESSION_CONFIG_REQUIRED.title: Scanning session config required
SCANNING_SESSION_CONFIG_REQUIRED.when: Configure this device from its scanning session.
SCANNING_SESSION_CONFIG_REQUIRED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCANNING_SESSION_MODE.title: Scanning session mode
SCANNING_SESSION_MODE.when: Open the device in its session’s mode.
SCANNING_SESSION_MODE.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCANNING_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.title: Scanning session not found
SCANNING_SESSION_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

SCANNING_SESSION_OPEN.title: Scanning session open
SCANNING_SESSION_OPEN.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCANNING_SESSION_SCOPE_INVALID.title: Scanning session scope invalid
SCANNING_SESSION_SCOPE_INVALID.when: Correct this scanning session’s scope and settings before adding devices.
SCANNING_SESSION_SCOPE_INVALID.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCANNING_SESSION_SETTINGS_INVALID.title: Scanning session settings invalid
SCANNING_SESSION_SETTINGS_INVALID.when: Correct this scanning session’s settings first.
SCANNING_SESSION_SETTINGS_INVALID.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCAN_ADMIN_SETUP_REQUIRED.title: Scan admin setup required
SCAN_ADMIN_SETUP_REQUIRED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCAN_BODY_INVALID.title: Scan body invalid
SCAN_BODY_INVALID.when: The request body is not valid JSON.
SCAN_BODY_INVALID.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_CONFIG_CHANGED.title: Scan configuration changed
SCAN_CONFIG_CHANGED.when: The scanning configuration changed between scan and save.
SCAN_CONFIG_CHANGED.fix: Reload the scanner and scan again.

SCAN_CREDENTIAL_CHANGED.title: Scan credential changed
SCAN_CREDENTIAL_CHANGED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCAN_DISPLAY_PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND.title: Scan display preview not found
SCAN_DISPLAY_PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

SCAN_EPOCHS_MISSING.title: Scan epochs missing
SCAN_EPOCHS_MISSING.when: Scan authority was not captured for this actor.
SCAN_EPOCHS_MISSING.fix: Retry once; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

SCAN_EVENT_NOT_FOUND.title: Event not found
SCAN_EVENT_NOT_FOUND.when: No scan event with this id exists in this mode and organization.
SCAN_EVENT_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the event id with GET /api/v1/scan/events.

SCAN_EXPORT_RANGE.title: Scan export range
SCAN_EXPORT_RANGE.when: Export up to 92 days at a time.
SCAN_EXPORT_RANGE.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE.title: Scan export too large
SCAN_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE.when: Export up to 100,000 scans at a time.
SCAN_EXPORT_TOO_LARGE.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_IN_PROGRESS.title: Scan in progress

SCAN_KEY_REUSED.title: Scan key reused
SCAN_KEY_REUSED.when: That request key was used for something else.
SCAN_KEY_REUSED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCAN_LIVE_ORIGIN.title: Scan live origin
SCAN_LIVE_ORIGIN.when: Open the screen on this site.
SCAN_LIVE_ORIGIN.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCAN_LOOKUP_DISABLED.title: Scan lookup disabled
SCAN_LOOKUP_DISABLED.when: Lookup is disabled for this scanner.
SCAN_LOOKUP_DISABLED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCAN_MARK_OUT_INVALID.title: Scan mark out invalid
SCAN_MARK_OUT_INVALID.when: That person cannot be marked out.
SCAN_MARK_OUT_INVALID.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_MODE_MISMATCH.title: Scan mode mismatch
SCAN_MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCAN_NOT_FOUND.title: Scan not found
SCAN_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

SCAN_NO_SESSION.title: Scan no session
SCAN_NO_SESSION.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN.title: Scan override forbidden
SCAN_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN.fix: No one can let them in.

SCAN_OVERRIDE_INVALID.title: Scan override invalid
SCAN_OVERRIDE_INVALID.when: That scan cannot be let through.
SCAN_OVERRIDE_INVALID.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_OVERRIDE_NOTE_CLOSED.title: Scan override note closed
SCAN_OVERRIDE_NOTE_CLOSED.when: That note can no longer be added.
SCAN_OVERRIDE_NOTE_CLOSED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_OVERRIDE_TAKEN.title: Scan override taken
SCAN_OVERRIDE_TAKEN.when: Someone else already let them in.
SCAN_OVERRIDE_TAKEN.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

SCAN_SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED.title: Scan scope not allowed
SCAN_SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED.when: A scanner cannot choose what it scans.
SCAN_SCOPE_NOT_ALLOWED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_SCOPE_REQUIRED.title: Scan scope required
SCAN_SCOPE_REQUIRED.when: Choose an organization to scan for.
SCAN_SCOPE_REQUIRED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_SEARCH_FORBIDDEN.title: Scan search forbidden
SCAN_SEARCH_FORBIDDEN.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCAN_SETTINGS_INVALID.title: Scan settings invalid
SCAN_SETTINGS_INVALID.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_SETUP_CONFLICT.title: Scan setup conflict
SCAN_SETUP_CONFLICT.when: Another session already scans this template.

SCAN_STAFF_CHANGED.title: Staff changed
SCAN_STAFF_CHANGED.when: The staff member or their settings changed while the request ran.

SCAN_STAFF_CURSOR.title: Scan staff cursor
SCAN_STAFF_CURSOR.when: That page is no longer valid.

SCAN_STAFF_NOT_FOUND.title: Scan staff not found
SCAN_STAFF_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

SCAN_SUMMARY_SESSION_FORBIDDEN.title: Scan summary session forbidden
SCAN_SUMMARY_SESSION_FORBIDDEN.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCAN_SURFACE_UNSUPPORTED.title: Scan surface unsupported
SCAN_SURFACE_UNSUPPORTED.when: A terminal cannot be used as a display.
SCAN_SURFACE_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

SCAN_UNDO_EXPIRED.title: Scan undo expired

SCAN_UNDO_EXPIRED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SCAN_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.title: Scan undo forbidden
SCAN_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.when: This scan cannot be undone by this operator.

SCAN_WINDOW_INVALID.title: Scan window invalid

SCREEN_ONLY.title: Screen only

SCREEN_REQUIRED.title: Screen required

SCREEN_REQUIRED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SESSION_OPEN_FORBIDDEN.title: Session open forbidden
SESSION_OPEN_FORBIDDEN.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

SESSION_REQUIRED.title: Signed-in user required
SESSION_REQUIRED.when: The action needs a signed-in user, not an API key.

SETTINGS_CHANGED.when: Another request changed the settings while yours ran.
SETTINGS_CHANGED.fix: Fetch them with GET /api/v1/settings and send your change again.

SQL_SIZE_BUDGET.title: Sql size budget
SQL_SIZE_BUDGET.fix: Retry once; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

STAFF_NAME_TAKEN.title: Staff name taken
STAFF_NAME_TAKEN.when: Another active staff member already has that name.
STAFF_NAME_TAKEN.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

STAFF_REQUIRED.title: Staff required
STAFF_REQUIRED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

STAFF_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.title: Staff sign in disabled
STAFF_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.when: Staff sign-in is not enabled on this scanner.
STAFF_SIGN_IN_DISABLED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

STAFF_SIGN_IN_UNAVAILABLE.title: Staff sign in unavailable
STAFF_SIGN_IN_UNAVAILABLE.when: Staff sign-in is only available on a paired scanner.
STAFF_SIGN_IN_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

STALE_CONTEXT.title: Sync context unavailable

STAMPS_ABOVE_MAX.title: Stamps above the maximum

STAMPS_ABOVE_MAX.fix: Raise the template's stamp maximum, or redeem stamps first.

STAMPS_CARD_FULL.title: Stamp card full

STAMPS_NONE.title: No stamps
STAMPS_NONE.when: The pass or template has no stamps.

STAMPS_NO_REWARD.title: No reward to redeem
STAMPS_NO_REWARD.when: The card is not full, so there is no reward.
STAMPS_NO_REWARD.fix: Add stamps until the card is full, then redeem.

STAMPS_QUERY.title: Stamp counts unreadable
STAMPS_QUERY.when: The stamp counts could not be read.

STAMPS_REDRAW.title: Stamp change needs the designer
STAMPS_REDRAW.when: A stamps change needs the card redrawn.
STAMPS_REDRAW.fix: Make the change in the template designer and publish a new version.

TAGS_OFF.title: Tags off

TAGS_OFF.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_ALREADY_ASSIGNED.title: Tag already assigned
TAG_ALREADY_ASSIGNED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.title: Tag approval required
TAG_APPROVAL_REQUIRED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

TAG_ASSIGN_FORBIDDEN.title: Tag assign forbidden
TAG_ASSIGN_FORBIDDEN.when: Assigning to a person is off on this scanner.

TAG_ASSURANCE_LOW.title: Tag assurance low
TAG_ASSURANCE_LOW.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_CARD_AMBIGUOUS.title: Tag card ambiguous
TAG_CARD_AMBIGUOUS.when: This scanner does not take that pass.

TAG_HOLDER_CHANGED.title: Tag holder changed
TAG_HOLDER_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_KEY_UNREADABLE.title: Tag key unreadable
TAG_KEY_UNREADABLE.when: A tag key could not be read.
TAG_KEY_UNREADABLE.fix: Retry once; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

TAG_LIMIT.title: Tag limit
TAG_LIMIT.when: This organization has the most tags allowed.
TAG_LIMIT.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_NOT_ASSIGNED.title: Tag not assigned
TAG_NOT_ASSIGNED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_NOT_FOUND.title: Tag not found
TAG_NOT_FOUND.when: No tag with this id exists in this mode and organization.

TAG_NO_ACCOUNT.title: Tag no account
TAG_NO_ACCOUNT.when: This person has no account yet.
TAG_NO_ACCOUNT.fix: Assign the tag to the pass instead.

TAG_PASS_NOT_ACCEPTED.title: Tag pass not accepted
TAG_PASS_NOT_ACCEPTED.when: This scanner does not take that pass.
TAG_PASS_NOT_ACCEPTED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

TAG_POOL_UNSUPPORTED.title: Tag pool unsupported
TAG_POOL_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Fix the fields listed in issues and send it again.

TAG_REQUEST_BUSY.title: Tag request busy
TAG_REQUEST_BUSY.when: A tag request is already open.

TAG_REQUEST_EXPIRED.title: Tag request expired
TAG_REQUEST_EXPIRED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_SCANNER_ONLY.title: Tag scanner only
TAG_SCANNER_ONLY.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

TAG_SUN_REPLAY.title: Tag sun replay

TAG_SUN_REPLAY.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_SYSTEM_DISABLED.title: Tag system disabled

TAG_TYPE_ARCHIVED.title: Tag type archived
TAG_TYPE_ARCHIVED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_TYPE_CHANGED.title: Tag type changed

TAG_TYPE_NAME_TAKEN.title: Tag type name taken

TAG_TYPE_NAME_TAKEN.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TAG_TYPE_NOT_FOUND.title: Tag type not found
TAG_TYPE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

TAG_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.title: Tag undo forbidden
TAG_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.when: Undo is on the scanner that assigned the tag.
TAG_UNDO_FORBIDDEN.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED.title: Template archived
TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED.when: The template is archived and cannot be used here.
TEMPLATE_ARCHIVED.fix: Restore it with POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/restore, or use another template.

TEMPLATE_ASSET_CONFLICT.title: Template asset conflict
TEMPLATE_ASSET_CONFLICT.when: A template asset was missing or differed right after the version was created.

TEMPLATE_BAKED.title: Built-in template
TEMPLATE_BAKED.when: The template is built in and cannot be archived or reused by name.
TEMPLATE_BAKED.fix: Clone it with POST /api/v1/templates/{id}/clone and change the clone.

TEMPLATE_BLUEPRINT_INACTIVE.title: Template blueprint inactive
TEMPLATE_BLUEPRINT_INACTIVE.when: This blueprint is no longer offered.

TEMPLATE_CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND.title: Candidate not found
TEMPLATE_CANDIDATE_NOT_FOUND.when: No release candidate with this id exists for the template.

TEMPLATE_CONFLICT.title: Template changed
TEMPLATE_CONFLICT.when: Another request changed the template while yours ran.
TEMPLATE_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch it with GET /api/v1/templates/{id} and send your change again.

TEMPLATE_CONTENT_CHANGED.title: Approved content changed
TEMPLATE_CONTENT_CHANGED.when: The template's approved content changed while the pass was being issued.
TEMPLATE_CONTENT_CHANGED.fix: Send the request again to use the current release.

TEMPLATE_EXISTS.title: Template exists
TEMPLATE_EXISTS.when: A template with this name exists.

TEMPLATE_IN_TAG_TYPE.title: Template in tag type
TEMPLATE_IN_TAG_TYPE.when: A tag type uses this template.
TEMPLATE_IN_TAG_TYPE.fix: Remove it from the type first.

TEMPLATE_IN_USE.title: Template in use
TEMPLATE_IN_USE.when: Scanning events or setups use this template.

TEMPLATE_IS_BLUEPRINT.title: Template is blueprint
TEMPLATE_IS_BLUEPRINT.fix: Use this blueprint to make one first.

TEMPLATE_MODE_MISMATCH.title: Template in another mode
TEMPLATE_MODE_MISMATCH.when: The template's mode differs from the key's or session's mode.
TEMPLATE_MODE_MISMATCH.fix: Use a key of the template's mode.

TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.title: Template not found
TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.when: No template with this id exists in this mode and organization.
TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id with GET /api/v1/templates and the key's mode.

TEMPLATE_NOT_RELEASED.title: Template not released
TEMPLATE_NOT_RELEASED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

TEMPLATE_NOT_SHAREABLE.title: Template cannot be shared
TEMPLATE_NOT_SHAREABLE.when: Only an unassigned upload can be shared.
TEMPLATE_NOT_SHAREABLE.fix: Share an upload that no organization has taken.

TEMPLATE_NOT_TESTED.title: Template not tested
TEMPLATE_NOT_TESTED.when: This version has not been released in Test.

TEMPLATE_ORG_REQUIRED.title: Template belongs to another organization
TEMPLATE_ORG_REQUIRED.when: The release action needs the template to belong to an organization.
TEMPLATE_ORG_REQUIRED.fix: Assign the template to an organization, then retry.

TEMPLATE_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.title: Wallet provider not configured
TEMPLATE_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.when: The wallet provider is not set up for template releases.
TEMPLATE_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Configure the provider for the organization, or release for another provider.

TEMPLATE_RELEASE_CONFLICT.title: Release changed
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_CONFLICT.when: The approved release changed while your request ran.
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_CONFLICT.fix: Send the request again to use the current release.

TEMPLATE_RELEASE_NOT_FOUND.title: Release not found
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_NOT_FOUND.when: No release with this id exists for the template.

TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.title: Approved release required
TEMPLATE_RELEASE_REQUIRED.when: The template has no approved release available in this mode.

TEMPLATE_SELF_APPROVAL.title: Template self approval
TEMPLATE_SELF_APPROVAL.when: The author cannot approve this candidate.
TEMPLATE_SELF_APPROVAL.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

TEMPLATE_SLUG_CONFLICT.title: Template name created meanwhile
TEMPLATE_SLUG_CONFLICT.when: Another template took the same name while yours was created.
TEMPLATE_SLUG_CONFLICT.fix: Send the request again, or choose a different name.

TEMPLATE_USED_BY_OTHER_ORG.title: Template used by other org
TEMPLATE_USED_BY_OTHER_ORG.when: Passes of another organization use this template.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Template version changed
TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONFLICT.when: Another request published a version while yours ran.
TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch the template and publish again.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONTENT_CONFLICT.title: Built-in content changed
TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONTENT_CONFLICT.when: A built-in template's content changed during synchronization.

TEMPLATE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND.title: Template version not found
TEMPLATE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND.when: The template has no version with this number.

TERMINAL_NOT_FOUND.title: Terminal not found
TERMINAL_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

TERMINAL_ONLY.title: Terminal only
TERMINAL_ONLY.when: A key acts only as a terminal.
TERMINAL_ONLY.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

TERM_MANAGED.title: Term set by a connection
TERM_MANAGED.when: A connection sets this pass's start, so it cannot be renewed here.
TERM_MANAGED.fix: Change the term in the connected system.

TERM_NONE.title: Pass has no term
TERM_NONE.when: The pass's template has no term to renew.
TERM_NONE.fix: Renew only passes whose template defines a term.

TERM_NOT_STARTED.title: Term not started
TERM_NOT_STARTED.when: The pass's term has not started yet.

TEST_FORWARD_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED.title: Email already forwarded
TEST_FORWARD_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED.when: This captured email is being sent or has an unknown delivery outcome.
TEST_FORWARD_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED.fix: Do not send it again; check your inbox first.

TEST_FORWARD_CHANGED.title: Forward changed
TEST_FORWARD_CHANGED.when: The email or the account changed while sending.

TEST_FORWARD_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.title: Test forward outcome unknown
TEST_FORWARD_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.fix: Do not send this message again.

TEST_FORWARD_PREPARATION_FAILED.title: Test forward preparation failed
TEST_FORWARD_PREPARATION_FAILED.when: The test email could not be prepared.

TEST_KEY_REQUIRED.title: Test key required
TEST_KEY_REQUIRED.when: Reading the test inbox needs a test-mode key.
TEST_KEY_REQUIRED.fix: Use a key that starts with pb_test_.

UNAUTHENTICATED.title: No credentials
UNAUTHENTICATED.when: The request has no valid credentials.

UNDO_SUPERSEDED.title: Undo superseded
UNDO_SUPERSEDED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

UNDO_UNCONFIRMED.title: Undo unconfirmed
UNDO_UNCONFIRMED.when: The undo could not be confirmed.
UNDO_UNCONFIRMED.fix: Retry once; if it persists, send the requestId to support.

UNKNOWN_TEMPLATE.title: Unknown template
UNKNOWN_TEMPLATE.when: A template id does not exist or belongs to another organization.

UNLOCK_REQUIRED.title: Unlock required
UNLOCK_REQUIRED.when: Enter a staff PIN to switch back.
UNLOCK_REQUIRED.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

UNSAFE_URL.title: URL not allowed
UNSAFE_URL.when: The URL is invalid, not https, or points to a blocked host.

UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND.title: Upload not found
UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND.when: No template upload with this id exists in this mode and organization.

USER_NOT_FOUND.title: User not found
USER_NOT_FOUND.when: No user with this id exists.

VALIDATION.title: Validation failed
VALIDATION.when: A body, query or path value breaks the schema.
VALIDATION.fix: Fix each field in issues and resend.

VERSION_CONFLICT.title: Stale version
VERSION_CONFLICT.when: If-Match holds an older version than the pass has.
VERSION_CONFLICT.fix: GET the pass, apply your change to it, and resend with the new version.

VERSION_INVALID.title: Template version invalid
VERSION_INVALID.when: The version cannot be released or compared.
VERSION_INVALID.fix: Use a version number from GET /api/v1/templates/{id}.

VERSION_NOT_FOUND.title: Version not found
VERSION_NOT_FOUND.when: The pass has no version with this number.

VERSION_PURGED.title: Version purged
VERSION_PURGED.when: This pass version is no longer stored.

VISITOR_CHANGED.title: Visitor changed
VISITOR_CHANGED.when: Another request changed the visitor while yours ran.
VISITOR_CHANGED.fix: Fetch the visitor list with GET /api/v1/visitors and send your change again.

VISITOR_HOST_NOTICE_FAILED.title: Host notice not sent
VISITOR_HOST_NOTICE_FAILED.when: The host could not be emailed.
VISITOR_HOST_NOTICE_FAILED.fix: Send the request again; the visit is still recorded.

VISITOR_HOST_UNKNOWN.title: Host unknown
VISITOR_HOST_UNKNOWN.when: The host is not a member of this organization.

VISITOR_NOT_FOUND.title: Visitor not found
VISITOR_NOT_FOUND.when: No visitor with this id exists in this mode and organization.

VISITOR_NOT_IN.title: Visitor not checked in
VISITOR_NOT_IN.when: The visitor has not checked in.
VISITOR_NOT_IN.fix: Check them in before this action.

VISITOR_OUT.title: Visitor already out
VISITOR_OUT.when: The visitor is already checked out.
VISITOR_OUT.fix: Do nothing; check status with GET /api/v1/visitors.

VISITOR_RESEND_LIMIT.title: Host notice limit reached
VISITOR_RESEND_LIMIT.when: The host was already emailed three times for this visit.

VISITOR_TEMPLATE_MISSING.title: Visitor template missing
VISITOR_TEMPLATE_MISSING.when: The organization has no visitor template set up.
VISITOR_TEMPLATE_MISSING.fix: Set up the visitor template in the console, then retry.

WALLET_ACCOUNT_CONFLICT.title: Wallet account conflict

WALLET_ART_MISMATCH.title: Wallet art mismatch

WALLET_OFFER_NOT_FOUND.title: Wallet offer not found

WALLET_OFFER_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

WALLET_OP_ACTOR.title: Wallet op actor

WALLET_OP_CONFIG.title: Wallet op config

WALLET_OP_CONFIG.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

WALLET_OP_LINEAGE.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

WALLET_OP_ORG.title: Wallet op org

WALLET_OP_ORG.fix: Use a key with the needed scope and mode, or ask an organization admin.

WALLET_OP_RELEASE.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

WALLET_OP_STALE.title: Wallet op stale

WALLET_OP_STALE.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

WALLET_PROJECTION_BLOCKED.title: Wallet projection blocked
WALLET_PROJECTION_BLOCKED.when: The request ran into wallet projection blocked.
WALLET_PROJECTION_BLOCKED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

WALLET_PROJECTION_CONFLICT.title: Wallet projection conflict
WALLET_PROJECTION_CONFLICT.when: The wallet projection, source release or provider account changed.
WALLET_PROJECTION_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

WALLET_PROJECTION_NOT_FOUND.title: Wallet projection not found
WALLET_PROJECTION_NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the id, mode and organization of the key.

WALLET_PROJECTION_SCHEMA.title: Wallet projection schema
WALLET_PROJECTION_SCHEMA.when: Create a new candidate: Google releases use the compiled wallet format.
WALLET_PROJECTION_SCHEMA.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

WALLET_PROJECTION_UNSUPPORTED.title: Wallet projection unsupported
WALLET_PROJECTION_UNSUPPORTED.when: This template contains wallet semantics that are not supported by the selected native projection.
WALLET_PROJECTION_UNSUPPORTED.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

WALLET_VERIFICATION_CONFLICT.title: Wallet verification conflict
WALLET_VERIFICATION_CONFLICT.when: A newer verification is in progress.
WALLET_VERIFICATION_CONFLICT.fix: Fetch the current resource, then send the change again.

WEBHOOK_ALREADY_FINISHED.title: Webhook work finished
WEBHOOK_ALREADY_FINISHED.when: The webhook item has already finished.
WEBHOOK_ALREADY_FINISHED.fix: Do nothing; check its status with GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/webhook-failures.

WEBHOOK_CONTEXT_CONFLICT.title: Webhook context changed
WEBHOOK_CONTEXT_CONFLICT.when: The connection changed after the webhook arrived.
WEBHOOK_CONTEXT_CONFLICT.fix: Resend the event from the source system.

WEBHOOK_DISPATCH_INCOMPLETE.title: Webhook dispatch incomplete
WEBHOOK_DISPATCH_INCOMPLETE.when: Not every retained webhook item was queued.

WEBHOOK_EFFECT_UNCERTAIN.title: Webhook outcome uncertain
WEBHOOK_EFFECT_UNCERTAIN.when: A webhook item may still be running or its outcome is unknown.
WEBHOOK_EFFECT_UNCERTAIN.fix: Resolve it with POST /api/v1/connections/{id}/webhook-failures/{retentionId}/resolve after checking the pass.

WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND.title: Webhook endpoint not found
WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND.when: No endpoint with this id exists in this mode and organization.

WEBHOOK_ENQUEUE_FAILED.title: Webhook not queued
WEBHOOK_ENQUEUE_FAILED.when: The webhook could not be queued for processing.

WEBHOOK_ITEM_BUSY.title: Webhook item busy
WEBHOOK_ITEM_BUSY.when: The webhook item is already running.

WEBHOOK_ITEM_PENDING.title: Webhook item pending
WEBHOOK_ITEM_PENDING.when: The webhook item has not finished processing.

WEBHOOK_NOTHING_TO_RESOLVE.title: Nothing to resolve
WEBHOOK_NOTHING_TO_RESOLVE.when: The connection has no uncertain webhook items.
WEBHOOK_NOTHING_TO_RESOLVE.fix: Do nothing; list failures with GET /api/v1/connections/{id}/webhook-failures.

WEBHOOK_NOT_FOUND.title: Webhook work not found
WEBHOOK_NOT_FOUND.when: No webhook item with this id exists for the connection.

WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD.title: Webhook body invalid
WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD.when: The incoming webhook body is not valid for this connector.
WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD.fix: Send the body in the format the connector documents.

WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_MISSING.title: Webhook payload missing
WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_MISSING.when: The stored webhook payload is not available.
WEBHOOK_PAYLOAD_MISSING.fix: Retry with backoff; if it persists, resend the event from the source.

WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE.title: Webhook configuration unavailable
WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE.when: The connection's webhook configuration could not be read.

WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE_CHANGED.title: Webhook mode changed
WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE_CHANGED.when: The connector's reference mode changed after the webhook arrived.
WEBHOOK_REFERENCE_MODE_CHANGED.fix: Resend the event from the source system.

WEBHOOK_RESOLVE_CONFLICT.title: Webhook changed
WEBHOOK_RESOLVE_CONFLICT.when: The webhook item changed while you resolved it.
WEBHOOK_RESOLVE_CONFLICT.fix: List failures again and resolve once more.

WEBHOOK_RETENTION_FAILED.title: Webhook not retained
WEBHOOK_RETENTION_FAILED.when: The webhook could not be stored for processing.

WEBHOOK_RETENTION_UNAVAILABLE.title: Webhook retention unavailable
WEBHOOK_RETENTION_UNAVAILABLE.when: The store for retained webhooks is unavailable.

WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE.title: Webhook signature invalid
WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE.when: The webhook signature does not match the connection's secret.
WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE.fix: Sign the body with the connection's current webhook secret.

WEBHOOK_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE.title: Original webhook context gone
WEBHOOK_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE.when: The context the webhook ran under is no longer stored.
WEBHOOK_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Resend the event from the source system instead of replaying.

WEBHOOK_STALE_CONTEXT.title: Webhook context stale
WEBHOOK_STALE_CONTEXT.when: The connection changed after the webhook arrived.
WEBHOOK_STALE_CONTEXT.fix: Resend the event from the source system.

WEBHOOK_STILL_PENDING.title: Webhook still queued
WEBHOOK_STILL_PENDING.when: The webhook item is still waiting to run.
WEBHOOK_STILL_PENDING.fix: Wait for it to run before resolving it.
